title: Early Peanut Eating Cut Allergy Risk 86%
hook: Early peanut eating cut allergy risk 86%.
closing: Medical advice should change when stronger evidence overturns the old rule.
question: Would you introduce peanut early?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4% of US children. Avoidance advice did not stop the increase.
Early peanut eating cut allergy risk 86%. The advice to avoid peanuts had the result backward.
Peanut diagnoses later fell 43% in young children. The guideline reversal is changing outcomes.
